# 07.16.03 XAL specification: Per-side

### Per-side

| Class | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `pt-{n}` | padding-top |
| `pr-{n}` | padding-right |
| `pb-{n}` | padding-bottom |
| `pl-{n}` | padding-left |
| `mt-{n}` | margin-top |
| `mr-{n}` | margin-right |
| `mb-{n}` | margin-bottom |
| `ml-{n}` | margin-left |

Multiple classes are space-separated: `class="pa-4 mt-2"`
